note: Controlled vocabulary for the Laya topic's second axis. It is deliberately not Jev's six — ADR-0018 says a topic's columns follow its own corpus, and Laya's corpus is runtimes, servers, agent plumbing and benchmark arguments rather than trading and browser agents. A tag outside this list fails npm run checks (scripts/check-intake.mjs), so a typo cannot produce a silently empty page. Rows that fit none of these stay untagged, which is why the kinds do not add up to the record count and the pages say so.
